name: Standard 30-Day Closing
summary: Conventional financing, the usual inspection and appraisal windows.

milestones.name: Offer Accepted
milestones.buyerNote: The seller has signed. From here it is a run of deadlines, and you will see each one land on this page as it happens.
milestones.waitingOn: Nothing — sit tight, we will tell you when we need you

milestones.name: Earnest Money Deposit
milestones.buyerNote: Your good-faith deposit goes to the escrow company. It is not a fee — it is credited back to you at closing.
milestones.waitingOn: You — wire the deposit to escrow

milestones.name: Home Inspection
milestones.buyerNote: An inspector spends two or three hours walking the home and sends a written report. You are welcome to come along.

milestones.name: Inspection Response
milestones.buyerNote: We decide together what to ask the seller for — repairs, a credit, or nothing — and send it over.
milestones.waitingOn: The seller's answer to our request

milestones.name: Appraisal
milestones.buyerNote: Your lender sends an appraiser to confirm the home is worth what you agreed to pay. Nothing is required from you.

milestones.name: Title Search
milestones.buyerNote: The title company checks that the seller can legally sell and that no old debts are attached to the property.

milestones.name: Loan Approval
milestones.buyerNote: Underwriting signs off on your file. This is the last big hurdle. Avoid new credit cards or job changes until it clears.

milestones.name: Final Walkthrough
milestones.buyerNote: We walk the home one last time to confirm it is in the condition you agreed to, and that any repairs were done.

milestones.name: Closing Day
milestones.buyerNote: You sign, the funds move, and the keys are yours. Bring photo ID.
